findings.title: Catch block treats every processing error as an SMS scheduling failure
findings.body: The new catch block increments retryCount for any error thrown anywhere in the large try block (lines 74-187), not only for twilio.scheduleSMS. This includes template rendering, getBookerBaseUrl, prisma.profile.findFirst, and bookingMetadataSchema.parse failures. A persistent non-scheduling error will therefore increment retryCount on each run and after retryCount reaches 2 the reminder is deleted by the deleteMany query, even though the SMS was never attempted. Scope the retryCount increment to scheduleSMS failures or otherwise distinguish scheduling failures from message-preparation/DB errors.

findings.title: deleteMany retryCount branch can delete non-SMS workflow reminders
findings.body: The OR branch `{ retryCount: { gt: 1 } }` is not constrained by `method: WorkflowMethods.SMS` or by `scheduled: false`. This handler is the SMS scheduling cron, but WorkflowReminder is shared by email and WhatsApp workflows, and retryCount is defined on the base model. Once any non-SMS reminder has retryCount > 1, this cron deletes it, causing cross-method data loss. Add `method: WorkflowMethods.SMS` and likely `scheduled: false` to this branch.

findings.title: retryCount updates are read-modify-write and can lose concurrent failures
findings.body: Both failure updates set `retryCount: reminder.retryCount + 1` using the value read when the reminders were loaded. If two cron invocations process the same unscheduled reminder concurrently, both can read the same retryCount and write the same value, so a failure is not recorded. Because deletion uses `retryCount > 1`, the reminder may never reach the deletion threshold and can continue being retried indefinitely. Use Prisma's atomic `retryCount: { increment: 1 }` in both updates or otherwise serialize the update.

findings.title: No tests for new retry/delete behavior
findings.body: The PR adds a retry count and a deletion threshold but includes no tests. Important cases are untested: scheduleSMS returning false or throwing increments retryCount, non-scheduling errors do not count as scheduling failures, retryCount > 1 deletion is scoped to SMS, and concurrent updates do not lose increments. Add unit/integration tests for this cron handler.
